Basin-hopping with annealed LogSumExp repulsion plus greedy worst-point re-insertion and trust-region LP polishing to change contact topology.
Iterated basin-hopping with annealed LogSumExp smoothing optimized by L-BFGS plus trust-region LP polishing to escape the flat jammed optimum.
Annealed soft-max sphere repulsion with Adam plus greedy single-point relocation kicks and trust-region LP polish to jump basins.

Basin-hopping from the record with Gaussian kicks, worst-pair separation kicks and worst-point void re-insertion, each smoothed by L-BFGS on a LogSumExp max-proxy with increasing sharpness, then squeezed by trust-region LP polish.

Basin-hopping around the record with worst-point-biased shakes and largest-hole reinsertions, each relaxed by annealed soft-max Riemannian Adam and squeezed by short trust-region LP, finishing with full LP polish.
Annealed log-sum-exp smoothing of the minimax with L-BFGS plus max-pair kicks and trust-region LP polishing to change basins.
Alternate L-BFGS LogSumExp annealing with single-point optimal re-insertion of worst vertices and trust-region LP polishing to break the single-pair jam.

Basin-hopping with wandering current state plus targeted hole-filling that re-optimizes endpoints of maximal pairs into largest voids, alternated with annealed LogSumExp L-BFGS and trust-region LP polishing.
Isolated-pair bottleneck micro-balancing plus multi-scale basin-hopping with annealed LogSumExp repulsion, greedy worst-point reinsertion and trust-region LP polishing.
Global single-point hole-search relocation of active max-pair points combined with annealed LogSumExp L-BFGS basin-hopping and trust-region LP polishing to force basin changes.
Global basin-hopping with cap-localized topology kicks plus annealed soft-max Adam and greedy worst-point reinsertion followed by trust-region LP polishing.
Basin-hopping from the record with annealed soft-max L-BFGS plus farthest-void relocation of the worst points and trust-region LP squeezing to change the contact topology.

Jammed optimum with ~700 tied pairs and zero rattlers needs multi-point basin jumps, so eject contact-cluster neighborhoods and greedily re-fill the hole farthest-first before L-BFGS LogSumExp annealing and LP polishing.
Alternate L-BFGS LogSumExp annealing with jammed-cluster surgery and multi-point void re-insertion plus trust-region LP polish to jump to a new basin.
Break the jam with exact single- and k-point optimal re-insertion plus kick-and-anneal L-BFGS LogSumExp basin hopping and trust-region LP polish.
Basin-hopping with contact-guided subgraph shakes and large-kick restarts feeding annealed LogSumExp L-BFGS plus final trust-region LP polish to escape the jammed basin.
Combine LogSumExp L-BFGS annealing with optimal single-point re-insertion of overloaded vertices and multi-scale trust-region LP micro-polishing to split the single-pair jam.

Ruin-and-recreate basin hopping that removes worst and spatially-clustered points and reinserts them into globally-optimized voids, alternated with annealed LogSumExp L-BFGS and trust-region LP polishing with wandering acceptance.
Knock out 2-3 worst jammed vertices and jointly re-optimize them with high-beta LogSumExp L-BFGS alternating with full-anneal and trust-region LP to jump basins.
Escape the flat jammed optimum by alternating annealed LogSumExp L-BFGS with void-hole re-insertion and jammed-cluster surgery plus trust-region LP squeezing.
Contact-degree-guided hub surgery with void re-insertion alternating LogSumExp L-BFGS annealing and trust-region LP polish to escape the fully-jammed basin.
Void-optimized basin hopping with L-BFGS LogSumExp annealing on all points plus sequential deepest-void re-insertion for worst offenders and trust-region LP polish.

Contact-guided basin hopping that shatters jammed clusters and reinserts worst points into largest spherical voids, alternating annealed soft-max Riemannian Adam, short L-BFGS LogSumExp refinement, greedy void reinsertion and trust-region LP polishing.
Metropolis basin-hopping with joint multi-void re-insertion, jammed-cluster relocation and random cap rotations feeding annealed LogSumExp L-BFGS plus trust-region LP squeeze.

Eject jammed contact clusters and jointly re-optimise multi-point blocks from farthest-void initialisations with low-beta LogSumExp exploration to force contact-topology changes, then re-anneal and LP-polish.
De novo symmetric search with sign-flip orbit codes plus E8-root seeding followed by symmetry release and full annealing with LP polish.
direction: Search de novo under imposed symmetry and only then break it: do not load the record except as a benchmark, and instead parametrise codes as orbits totalling 121 points under a subgroup $G$ of the signed-permutation group $B_8$ (generated programmatically from random even sign changes and coordinate permutations, choosing orbit sizes that sum to 121, e.g. one fixed point plus orbits of sizes 8, 16, or 32), optimise only the few orbit representatives with high-$\beta$ LogSumExp L-BFGS, seed additional families from the 240 $E_8$ roots by greedy max-min selection of 121 roots followed by swap moves, then gradually release the symmetry tying (representatives first move together, then all 121 points move freely) with LP polish at each release stage, retaining any released code whose contact graph differs from the record's.

idea: Deflated target-feasibility continuation on hinge loss with hole-grown and fresh starts plus Procrustes tabu, promoting distinct survivors to LogSumExp annealing and LP polish.
direction: Run a target-feasibility continuation in both threshold and point count, deflated away from the known basin: for targets $t=0.4600,0.4595,0.4590,\dots$ minimise the hinge loss $\sum_{i<j}\mathrm{relu}(\langle x_i,x_j\rangle-t)^2$ by Adam/L-BFGS from many fresh starts, including codes grown from optimised 115--120 point codes by inserting each new point at the numerically largest spherical hole (dense random sampling plus single-point refinement) and re-optimising all points, and add a tabu penalty that, after optimal orthogonal Procrustes alignment to the record configuration, penalises RMSD below $0.05$ so restarts cannot collapse back onto it; promote only the best few distinct survivors to full LogSumExp annealing and trust-region LP polish, and report the smallest feasible $t$ found.
